'''Stygeon''' was a [[Water/Legends|snowy]], [[Mountain/Legends|mountainous]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that was home to a secret [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Spire (Stygeon)/Legends|prison]]. [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Sidious]] imprisoned his former [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] after his excursion as a [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]]. Maul escaped with the help of his [[Mandalorian super commando/Legends|Mandalorian super commandos]].<ref name="Son of Dathomir 1" />

==Behind the scenes==
Stygeon first appeared in the [[Darth Maul — Son of Dathomir 1|first issue]] of the [[Star Wars: Darth Maul — Son of Dathomir|''Star Wars: Darth Maul—Son of Dathomir'']] miniseries,<ref name="Son of Dathomir 1" /> released on [[May 21]], [[2014]].<ref name="DarkHorse">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/24-765/Star-Wars-Darth-Maul-Son-of-Dathomir-1|text=Star Wars: Darth Maul&mdash;Son of Dathomir #1}}</ref> Prior to the comic's release, it was mentioned in the [[Blaster (department)|''Blaster'']] segment of [[Star Wars Insider 149|149th issue]] of ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'',<ref name="Insider149">{{InsiderCite|149|Blaster}}</ref> [[April 22]], 2014.<ref name="Announcement">{{Facebook|username=starwarsbooks|url=starwarsbooks/photos/a.414408798712/10152285492768713|name=Star Wars Books|date=2014-03-13}}</ref> [[Jason Fry]], co-author of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', indicated in [[March]] [[2023]] that Stygeon was validated for a future update of [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]].<ref name="Email">{{EmailCite|email=File:EAOC discussion 2023.jpg|creator=Jason Fry|date=2023-03-25}}</ref>
